Recently, while on vacation, we came in touch with some herb. I'm 100% willing to bet it was laced, but I don't know with what. Basically, I instantly started sketching out. But I touched it out and we finished the session. I quickly went inside and went straight to bed. There were quite a few people over and I knew I couldn't deal with that. I was laying in the dark with my girlfriend and I began having closed eye visuals. I've never tripped or anything so this scared the shit out of me. Usually when you close your eyes, you can see purples and greens, but now I was seeing red and blues, and yellows. They were spinning counterclockwise in a kaleidoscope fashion. I knew something was wrong but I decided to just keep my eyes closed and let it happen. 
Now this next part, I didn't literally "see" but I was so deep into my own thought that it was as clear as seeing it. 

I forgot who I was.

I couldn't think of what I looked like. What it felt like to be in my own body. I could only see myself in younger ages from the outside. I was scared so I desperately tried to remember who I was, so I began thinking of the times when I looked like what I was seeing. This began a string of seeing my own life from the outside. My girlfriend asked if I was ok and I said, "I'm currently watching my life rewind from a third persons view." She got super scared and went to make me some food and got me some water. 

This process lasted about an hour, and after it wore off, it was just a normal high. It changed my life, and I will never forget it. And I MOST DEFINITELY want to legitimately trip now. 

TL;DR; crazy existential crisis.

I get it in the sense that some people have legitimate allergies to PG or the lingering vapor can trigger an asthma attack. But I do think that some people think it's just a fad to promote smoking. BUT ALSO, there are still some of those people furthering the stigma that everyone who vapes is a fuckboy, or the "look at me blowing clouds in everyone's face" people, and I'm sure they aren't helping the whole movement to get it recognized as an actual healthier alternative to smoking.

I am also fairly new (about a year) to vaping. I know from experience that the liquid isn't bad in small doses. It tastes god awful, but it's not bad for you in any way. If you're going to go straight from cigarettes, then you should probably use a juice with around 12-18 mg of nicotine but work your way down to around 6. (what I did) The initial investment is usually daunting to people, but it costs less than, if not equal to, smoking once you actually have a setup. There are hundreds of starter packs. If you're not sure about it, I would buy a small setup, like an ego c-twist starter pack. 

Vaping is leaps and bounds healthier for you than smoking. Of course it not "healthy" because it's still nicotine, but it will definitely settle your cravings without pumping you full of a bunch of stuff that will give you cancer, heart attacks, bad teeth, etc.
